entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane, made dark and frigid by the Ice Age.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: The continent of Dominaria where the Brothers' War and the Ice Age storyline took place.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war that ended with the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: The blast ending the Brothers' War, powerful enough to alter the planet's climate.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: The era of glaciers and blizzards in which new cultures fought for survival.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: The villain necromancer who unleashed a horde of undead during the Ice Age.

events.summary: The Sylex Blast ends the Brothers' War and alters Dominaria's climate, beginning the Ice Age.
events.quote: That war ended with the Sylex Blast , which was powerful enough to alter the planet's climate

events.summary: Lim-Dûl unleashes a horde of undead, forcing old enemies to work together.
events.quote: when the necromancer Lim-Dûl unleashed a horde of undead , old enemies were forced to work together or be overwhelmed

relations.quote: occurred on the continent of Terisiare
